episodes.title: Carbon… SO SIMPLE
episodes.description: Join Hank Green and learn about covalent, ionic, and hydrogen bonds.

episodes.title: Water – Liquid Awesome
episodes.description: Hank teaches us why water is one of the most fascinating and important substances in the universe.

episodes.title: Biological Molecules – You Are What You Eat
episodes.description: Examine carbohydrates, lipids, and proteins, including where these biological molecules occur in food and the environment.

episodes.title: Eukaryopolis – The City of Animal Cells
episodes.description: Hank tells us about the city of Eukaryopolis - the animal cell that is responsible for all the cool things that happen in our bodies.

episodes.title: In Da Club – Membranes & Transport
episodes.description: Hank describes how cells regulate their contents and communicate with one another via mechanisms within the cell membrane.

episodes.title: Plant Cells
episodes.description: Hank describes why plants are so amazing - discussing their evolution, and how their cells are both similar to & different from animal cells.

episodes.title: ATP & Respiration
episodes.description: Follow cellular respiration and the processes cells use to produce ATP.

episodes.title: Photosynthesis
episodes.description: Explore the reactions that let plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make food.

episodes.title: Heredity
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Biology, Hank Green and his brother John discuss heredity via the gross example of relative ear wax moistness.

episodes.title: DNA Structure and Replication
episodes.description: Hank introduces DNA’s molecular structure and explains how cells copy it.

episodes.title: DNA, Hot Pockets, & The Longest Word Ever
episodes.description: Learn how transcription and translation turn genetic instructions into proteins through a factory analogy.

episodes.title: Mitosis – Splitting Up is Complicated
episodes.description: Follow mitosis and cytokinesis as a cell divides to produce two matching copies.

episodes.title: Meiosis – Where the Sex Starts
episodes.description: Hank gets down to the nitty gritty about meiosis, the special type of cell division that is necessary for sexual reproduction in eukaryotic organisms.

episodes.title: Natural Selection
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Biology, Hank Green guides us through the process of natural selection, the key mechanism of evolution.

episodes.title: Speciation – Of Ligers & Men
episodes.description: Hank Green explains speciation - the evolutionary process by which new biological species arise - in terms of finches, ligers, mules, and dogs.

episodes.title: Animal Development – We’re Just Tubes!
episodes.description: Explore the processes that allow organisms to grow and develop.

episodes.title: Evolutionary Development – Chicken Teeth
episodes.description: Compare developmental processes across organisms to understand evolutionary relationships and the evolution of development.

episodes.title: Population Genetics – When Darwin Met Mendel
episodes.description: Connect Mendelian genetics with evolution to understand population change and the Hardy-Weinberg equation.

episodes.title: Taxonomy – Life’s Filing System
episodes.description: Discover the history and purpose of taxonomy, the classification of living organisms.

episodes.title: Evolution – It’s a Thing
episodes.description: Explore how gene distributions change across generations and contribute to biological diversity.

episodes.title: Comparative Anatomy – What Makes Us Animals
episodes.description: Compare animal anatomies to see how similarities and differences provide evidence for shared ancestry and evolution.

episodes.title: Simple Animals – Sponges, Jellies, & Octopuses
episodes.description: Compare sponges, mollusks, and other animals by the number and complexity of their tissue layers.

episodes.title: Complex Animals – Annelids & Arthropods
episodes.description: Examine the animal phyla Annelida and Arthropoda, with a closer look at insects.

episodes.title: Chordates
episodes.description: Explore the diversity of chordates and discover where humans fit within this animal group.

episodes.title: Animal Behavior
episodes.description: Hank and his cat introduce animal behavior and ways to investigate why animals act as they do.

episodes.title: The Nervous System
episodes.description: Explore the nervous system and the many functions it coordinates throughout the body.

episodes.title: Circulatory & Respiratory Systems
episodes.description: Follow the circulatory and respiratory systems as they deliver oxygen to cells and remove carbon dioxide.

episodes.title: The Digestive System
episodes.description: Follow digestion through the human body and discover the importance of surface area.

episodes.title: The Excretory System – From Your Heart to the Toilet
episodes.description: Trace the excretory system and learn how the kidneys produce urine.

episodes.title: The Skeletal System – It’s ALIVE!: CrashCourse Biology
episodes.description: Learn how the skeleton supports and protects the body while carrying out other essential functions.

episodes.title: Big Guns – The Muscular System
episodes.description: Explore the chemical interactions that make skeletal muscles contract and relax.

episodes.title: Your Immune System – Natural Born Killer
episodes.description: Discover how the immune system defends the body against threats.

episodes.title: Great Glands – Your Endocrine System
episodes.description: Explore hormone-producing glands and how their secretions regulate growth, metabolism, and reproductive functions.

episodes.title: The Reproductive System – How Gonads Go
episodes.description: Explore reproduction and the workings of the reproductive system.

episodes.title: Old & Odd – Archaea, Bacteria & Protists
episodes.description: Explore Archaea, Bacteria, and Protists, the abundant and mostly single-celled organisms beyond human anatomy.

episodes.title: The Reproductive Lives of Nonvascular Plants – Alternation of Generations
episodes.description: Hank introduces us to nonvascular plants - liverworts, hornworts & mosses - which have bizarre features, kooky habits, and strange sex lives.

episodes.title: Vascular Plants = Winning!
episodes.description: Explore vascular plants and how conductive tissues transport nutrients and water, supporting their growth and spread.

episodes.title: The Plants & The Bees – Plant Reproduction
episodes.description: Compare reproduction in ferns, gymnosperms, and angiosperms through the alternation of generations.

episodes.title: Fungi – Death Becomes Them
episodes.description: Explore how fungi decompose organic matter and return nutrients to food webs.

episodes.title: Ecology – Rules for Living on Earth
episodes.description: Explore ecology and the interactions between living organisms and their environments.
